title: Skill Install Payload Schema
description: Output shape of `qdev install skills --json`. Reports installed editor and agent skill bundles. Schema changes follow semver on schema_version; additive fields do not bump the major.

targets.description: Selected installation target environments (e.g. claude, cursor, agents).

installed_files.description: Workspace-relative paths to the installed skill and rule files.

version.description: The binary version stamped into the installed skills.
